observation_unit: de-duplicated BSM receive event with a causal trajectory window

attacker_emitter_localization_protocol.metric: recall of attacker-labeled sender clusters among the top-k senders ranked by maximum message anomaly score over the test split
attacker_emitter_localization_protocol.interpretation: retrospective attacker-emitter ranking, not event-level component localization or causal root-cause accuracy

preprocessing.missing_values: feature validity masks retained; missing values set to normalized zero
preprocessing.split_policy: official train/validation/test paths; no random test subsampling
preprocessing.receiver_copy_policy: same sender/messageID/sendTime receiver copies collapsed by parser; earliest receive_time_ns retained

simulated_mttd.time_basis: VeReMi simulator receive_time_ns; test-entry positive sequences are left-censored; not field-incident MTTD

training.threshold_selection: maximum F1 on official validation split

uncertainty.method: paired nonparametric bootstrap resampling test sender IDs as clusters
uncertainty.seed_metrics_note: Rows are source-cluster bootstrap resamples, not independent corridor-days, random test partitions, or independent scenarios.

scope_limits.attacker_emitter_localization: sender-level risk ranking only; not causal root-cause attribution
scope_limits.simulated_mttd: message-level delay after a labeled simulator attacker transition; not field-incident MTTD
